hook: Your AI agent works for its parent company, not you.
hookText: Your AI agent works for its parent company, not you.

beats.say: LLM agents are built to serve the interests of the companies that deploy them, not the people talking to them.
The piece argues that when the company's goals and your request point in different directions, the agent follows the company, not you.
So the question is not what your agent can do, but whose interests it is built to serve.
